properties.name: Rioja Alta & Rioja Alavesa
properties.category: Aristocratic, long-lived Tempranillo Gran Reservas, single-parcel Viñedos Singulares, and cellar-worthy oak-aged Viura whites.
properties.description: The historical heart of Spanish fine wine. Cool Atlantic ocean breezes meet continental sunshine, crafting wines of noble restraint, spicy cedar complexity, and decades-long cellaring capacity.

properties.name: Ribera del Duero (Castilian High Plateau)
properties.category: Monumental, muscular, inky Tinto Fino (Tempranillo) displaying blackberry, graphite, balsamic freshness, and noble aging potential.
properties.description: The fortress of Castilian viticulture. Extreme altitude and diurnal swings forge Tempranillo of legendary power, concentration, and aristocratic grandeur.

properties.name: Priorat (DOQ Priorat & Llicorella Slate)
properties.category: Intense, inky old-vine Garnacha Tinta and Cariñena (Samsó) marked by crushed slate minerality, wild scrub herbs (garrique), and immense palate presence.
properties.description: One of only two DOQ/DOCa regions in Spain. Extreme mountain slopes and black slate create wines of primordial mineral intensity, dark fruit liqueur, and unforgettable tension.

properties.name: Rías Baixas (Val do Salnés & Atlantic Galicia)
properties.category: The world benchmark for Albariño: crystalline, saline, citrus-driven dry whites with tactile granite minerality, white floral perfume, and immense longevity when aged on lees (sobre lías).
properties.description: Spain's green Atlantic paradise. Decomposed granite soils, perpetual ocean breezes, and ancient pergolas craft the world's most electrifying, saline-mineral white wines from indigenous Albariño.

properties.name: Rioja Oriental (Warm Ebro Lowlands)
properties.category: Warm, spicy, succulent Garnacha Tinta and structured, dark-fruited Graciano.
properties.description: The sun-kissed Mediterranean gateway of Rioja, undergoing a massive quality renaissance through high-altitude Garnacha single-vineyard bottlings.
